elements.name: Leadership
elements.description: Trust in, and direction from, senior leaders.
statements: I have confidence in the decisions our senior leaders make
Leaders here explain the reasons behind major changes
Senior management acts on feedback from employees
I understand where leadership wants the company to go
Our leaders set a good example for the rest of us
Leaders here are visible and approachable
I often feel left in the dark about leadership's plans
Our leaders genuinely care about the wellbeing of staff

elements.name: Growth & Development
elements.description: Room to learn, stretch and progress.
statements: My work gives me the chance to build new skills
I can see a realistic path for my next career step here
My targets push me to improve without being unrealistic
I get useful coaching or mentoring when I need it
I have had meaningful training in the last twelve months
My talents are not fully used in my current role
Promotions here are based on merit
I am encouraged to take on new challenges

elements.name: Company Pride
elements.description: How employees see and speak about the company.
statements: I would recommend this company to a friend looking for a job
I speak positively about the company outside work
I am proud to tell people where I work
Our customers would describe us as a good company to deal with
I see myself still working here in two years
I would leave if a similar job came up elsewhere
The company has a good reputation in our industry
I believe in the products or services we provide

elements.name: Ownership
elements.description: Feeling responsible for, and able to influence, results.
statements: I know how my work affects the company's results
I have the authority I need to do my job well
I treat problems at work as mine to help solve
I put in extra effort when the company needs it
I am trusted to decide how to do my work
I am held back by too many approvals and rules
My ideas can make a real difference here
I care about the company's success, not just my own tasks

elements.name: Communication
statements: I can raise concerns without fear of negative consequences
My manager regularly asks for my views
I get the information I need to do my job on time
Communication between departments works well
I can reach managers above my own when I need to
I usually hear about important news through rumours first
Feedback I receive about my work is clear and useful
Meetings here are a good use of my time

elements.name: Culture & Belonging
statements: I feel I belong in this company
I share the values this company stands for
People here respect different backgrounds and working styles
My colleagues support each other when things get busy
I am treated fairly regardless of who I know
Office politics get in the way of good work here
I enjoy working with my team
Mistakes are treated as chances to learn

elements.name: Reward & Recognition
elements.description: Pay, benefits and appreciation for effort.
statements: I am paid fairly for the work I do
My pay compares well with similar jobs elsewhere
Good work is noticed and appreciated here
The way performance is rewarded motivates me
Our benefits meet my needs
Extra effort makes little difference to what I receive
My manager thanks me when I do a good job
Recognition here is given fairly

elements.name: Social Responsibility
elements.description: The company's contribution to community and environment.
statements: The company makes a positive contribution to the community
I have opportunities to take part in community activities through work
The company takes its environmental impact seriously
I understand how our community efforts link to our purpose
The company behaves ethically even when it costs money
Our community activities feel more like publicity than real effort
Employees are encouraged to suggest community initiatives
I am proud of what the company does beyond business

overall: Overall, I am satisfied working at this company
I am motivated to give my best at work every day
I rarely think about looking for a job elsewhere

tiers.name: Champion
tiers.profile: Fully committed; inspires others and goes the extra mile.

tiers.name: Engaged
tiers.profile: Feels valued and important to the business; a consistent achiever.

tiers.name: Steady
tiers.profile: Contributes reliably and is proud of their work, but could be tempted away.
tiers.action: Talk with them about what would raise their commitment.

tiers.name: Wavering
tiers.profile: Unsure about the work, the team or the manager; may be job hunting.

tiers.name: Disengaged
tiers.profile: Here mainly for the pay; may be undermining morale.
